x: Charlie Redgrave, "The Banjulele Boy", passes Alf Harley only feet from the tape to win the 1929 Boxing Day Walk Handicap. It was only a year after his election as Club "Scribe" that Alf took on the additional responsibility of Walking Hon.
(BILL) REDGRAVE We have to record with regret the death of Bill Redgrave, a Vice-President of the Club, and a member for over fifty years.
Our first stab at actually naming the faces came up with Don Brown (1), Harry Churcher (7), Charlie Churcher (23), C.W. Redgrave (24) and Alf Harley (behind Brown).
